description:
-= Laundromat =-
You're now in a laundromat. Okay, just remember what you're here to do, and everything will go great.

You can see a type A safe. Hmm. You always thought you'd be more excited to see a type A safe in a room.

You need an unblocked exit? You should try going west.

There is a type A latchkey on the floor.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, open the type A safe within the laundromat. And then, retrieve the sock from the type A safe in the laundromat. Got that? Good!
